brief: An unofficial index of Behind the Bastards stories by period, theme, place and who the subjects were. It should feel like a serious reference work that is in on the joke, without borrowing the show's artwork or colours.
criteria: Success: reads as a reference work and as a joke in one glance, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, distinct from reference-site and podcast cliches.

concepts.name: Volume B
concepts.idea: Volume B of an encyclopedia that has grown a horn, wears a slipped halo and keeps a devil's tail as its bookmark.
rationale: Reference work first: a bound volume with a spine and a serif B
The joke is built in: saint and sinner on one cover, like the show's bastards and heroes
Oxblood and gilt: old leather binding, and the gold makes the halo read as a halo
A simplified cut keeps the B legible as a 16 px favicon

recommendation: Volume B in oxblood and gilt (palette O2). Episcopal violet and brass (A4) is kept as an alternative in brand/proposals/a4-aubergine.
next_steps: Logo in the site header and the new favicon and app icons
Professional trademark search before the public launch
Optional: a pattern or icon set built from the book and halo shapes
